Rules, fixed before any script runs (helpers d5f_*.py, keyed on a form letter, for all six legs): (1) rule 6 as declared at D5a-01: an arrow's expectation is its subs over the 705 analysed rooms over 705 times the form's n (all members); below one not-testable-here, and no absence or failed proposition from it. (2) Thin and core rooms weigh less: every share, signature, theme count, representative choice and split is read on the defining rooms only (base: the 558 defining rooms); thin and core members are named and their lines described apart; verdicts and local statuses are given for all, defining apart. (3) Element and arrow by element and arrow: for each element and arrow, the defining members with a selected line of each op against the 558; ops read as specify (add-condition, add-step), restrict, replace (contradict) and connect (link); the kind is not relied on (J, kappa 0.08). (4) Restrict lines on arrows by defining members: I read every how sentence and sort it as the arrow fails here (the line says the consequent came without the antecedent, from another source, or in another order), the record cannot show it (the line says the order, the link or the step is not visible or not dated in the record), or both or neither; my sort is written to a file before counting. (5) Representative rooms: fit is a defining member's distance to the form's centre in the allocation's 892 columns; best two: the nearest with selected changes and coded concepts at or above the form's defining medians; least well: the farthest; read at length: among the ten nearest, the one with the most selected changes not read at length earlier in stage D5. (6) The split below the form, from room-forms-tree-rooms.tsv, in the order the cuts make it: a split reads as a split when both parts hold 10 defining rooms or more and each has a change column (fourth-order node or link) at 1.5 times the parent's defining share or more, held by a third of the part or more and by fewer in the other part; descend only while splits read. (7) Branches: for each of the 35, the form's members in it against the form's share of 705 rooms. (8) Nearest form: by centres; the room that could have gone either way: the defining member with the smallest margin to another centre. (9) Themes over and under: d5_themes' rule on the defining members' codes. (10) The canvas is not used; survival from the record (organizing_end-A1.jsonl) for the jsonl line only.
